variants.label: Wireless checkout
variants.purpose: Review the SSID state change beside independent FTD action and application dependency observations without assigning cause.
claim_limits: Meraki SSID state, FTD action, and application dependency are independent observations.
Administrator relationships show potential relevance only; they do not prove ownership or cause.
No native FMC policy edit or deployment success is represented.

variants.label: Backend rollout
variants.purpose: Review stable Service identity with a new Pod UID and EndpointSlice membership.
claim_limits: Service identity and selector stay constant while a distinct native Pod UID and EndpointSlice target are observed.
Traffic and INTERNAL spans are independent observations; no failed request, deployment actor, or exact apply time is asserted.

variants.label: NAT boundary
variants.purpose: Inspect the native same-event translated tuple beside independent downstream evidence.
claim_limits: NAT values are retained as same-event source context only if the reviewed normal projection exposes them.
The independent downstream flow is not joined across events to the translated tuple or a backend.

variants.label: Wireless IP reuse
variants.purpose: Retain IP-level flow while withholding a unique station assignment across two MACs.
claim_limits: Two valid association observations claim the same IP; traffic remains IP-level.
Do not assign a unique client station or combine the two station identities.

variants.label: Partial source collection
variants.purpose: Show a partial SSID collection and later complete observation without converting missing coverage into deletion.
claim_limits: The change poll is an explicitly partial synthetic local collection; no absence-derived deletion or carry-forward through the gap is permitted.
The later complete poll is a later observation and does not retroactively close the gap.

variants.label: Restricted history visibility
variants.purpose: Continue permitted traffic investigation while verifying that this caller cannot validate selected history.
claim_limits: A clean empty activation lookup means the selected history is not visible to this tested caller; it does not mean no changes or complete history.
Administrator history access is limited to proof that this run’s exact activation exists; graph and endpoint traffic use the same restricted caller.

variants.label: FMC policy deployment
variants.purpose: Native FMC policy history and per-device deployment evidence.
variants.reason: FMC policy detail, audit and per-device deployment schemas remain unqualified.
variants.current_evidence: FTD action records and normalized exports do not establish a native FMC edit or deployment.
variants.unblock_evidence: Version-matched sanitized native responses, safe allowlisted projection, immutable ordered rule history and actual per-device deployment linkage.

variants.label: NX-OS interface configuration
variants.purpose: A qualified interface configuration transition.
variants.reason: The current source adapter refuses configuration inputs pending versioned command/DME samples and stable interface identity.
variants.current_evidence: Device inventory is context only and no configuration transition was collected.
variants.unblock_evidence: Versioned native before/after records, stable chassis/interface mapping and complete polling bounds.

variants.label: AppDynamics control
variants.purpose: A typed monitoring configuration and measurement control.
variants.reason: Controller audits do not provide qualified typed targets or historical application-model bindings.
variants.current_evidence: No monitoring change or successful measurement is asserted.
variants.unblock_evidence: Sanitized versioned resource schema, stable Controller/app/tier/node links, retained revisions and measurement compatibility rules.

variants.label: ThousandEyes control
variants.purpose: A qualified test configuration and measurement control.
variants.reason: Activity names do not prove test IDs, historical agent assignments or frozen test configuration.
variants.current_evidence: No successful probe or configuration comparison is asserted.
variants.unblock_evidence: Native resource/account crosswalk, versioned target/protocol/port/agent bindings and measurement units/coverage.

variants.label: Branch checkout
variants.purpose: Review the ACI database ACL observation separately from frontend traffic and unresolved network audit context.
claim_limits: Campus and SD-WAN records are distinct observations and are not summed as unique connections or ordered path.
ACI database ACL action is observed separately from frontend traffic.
Administrator relationships show potential relevance only; they do not prove ownership or cause.

variants.label: Service backend change
variants.purpose: Review a stable Service selector with a distinct Pod UID and EndpointSlice member.
claim_limits: Service identity and selector remain stable while native Pod UID and EndpointSlice membership change.
Traffic and INTERNAL spans are independent observations; no enforcement or request-success claim.

variants.label: ACI endpoint attachment
variants.purpose: Compare two receipt-bounded operational attachment observations for the same native endpoint DN.
claim_limits: Only same-authority, same-DN attachment fields are compared; observations are receipt-bounded operational state.
No EPG move, deletion, VRF relationship, configured intent, apply time, or causal path is inferred.

variants.reason: The native audit record has no proven site, VPN, policy target or per-device deployment status.
variants.unblock_evidence: Qualified target schemas, stable device/site/VPN relation and separate per-device deployment completion/time evidence.

variants.label: Campus provisioning
variants.purpose: A task/resource/device-linked campus configuration action.
variants.reason: Generic Catalyst audit IDs do not identify affected configuration or completed deployment.
variants.current_evidence: Current client snapshots and generic audit pass do not supply the required target/action chain.
variants.unblock_evidence: Version-matched task/resource/device linkage, completion and historical interface/client binding with receipt.

variants.label: Cilium policy enforcement
variants.purpose: Native policy configuration and compatible enforcement evidence.
variants.reason: The admitted Cilium adapter retains metadata/generation only, not policy specification or enforcement semantics.
variants.current_evidence: Metadata and traffic timestamps do not establish policy application or verdict.
variants.unblock_evidence: Versioned CRD schema and sanitized policy instances, reviewed safe projection and compatible native applied/verdict evidence.

variants.label: Cross-EPG endpoint movement
variants.purpose: Durable native identity continuity across an EPG move.
variants.reason: The endpoint DN is EPG-scoped and available examples do not prove a stable cross-EPG relation.
variants.current_evidence: Same-DN attachment observations remain operational only; no movement is inferred.
variants.unblock_evidence: Version-matched fvRsVm.tDn relation targeting the same compVm.dn across the change with parent/child receipts and separate native VRF chain.
